## 0.1.16
### 新增 / New
- 小屋相邻房间之间画出连通门洞，多层户型增加楼梯；经典四室也使用同一套合成画法 / Adjoining house rooms now connect through doorways, with stairs between floors; the classic four-room layout uses the same composed artwork - 可在地板自由摆放装饰，门洞和楼梯会留空，并提供专门的摆放提示 / Place decorations freely on the floor, with doorways and stairs kept clear and dedicated placement hints - 风格包支持按需下载并校验 SHA-256，温馨木屋仍然内置 / Style packs support on-demand downloads with SHA-256 verification; Cozy Wood remains bundled - 有厨房、卫生间或阳台时，默认自动布局会把这些房间排进户型 / The default automatic layout now includes a kitchen, bathroom or balcony when present - 新增短毛宠物狗；猫会被家具遮挡，并对设备做出反应：空调旁趴窝、进门跑来、躲避扫地机 / New short-haired pet dog; cats are occluded by furniture and react to devices by lounging near the AC, running to the entrance and avoiding robot vacuums - 窗帘（含开合位置）、冰箱、洗衣机、热水器、加湿器、扫地机、空气净化器、暖气、除湿机、水壶、洗碗机、榨汁机和电磁炉新增独立详情页与插画 / Dedicated detail pages and illustrations for curtains (with position controls), fridges, washers, water heaters, humidifiers, robot vacuums, air purifiers, heaters, dehumidifiers, kettles, dishwashers, juicers and induction cooktops
### 改进 / Improved
- 宠物花色预览更清晰，短毛猫睡觉姿势更协调 / Clearer pet coat previews and better-proportioned sleeping poses for short-haired cats - 界面圆角、字体和详情页键盘焦点更统一 / More consistent corner radii, typography and keyboard focus on detail pages - 补全音箱、厨房电器、净水器、人体传感器和在线打印机的演示设备 / More complete demo devices for speakers, kitchen appliances, water purifiers, motion sensors and online printers
